description: This file defines functions for managing OpenAI assistants, including listing all assistants, retrieving a single assistant with associated files, and uploading files to an assistant. It interacts with OpenAI API, database credentials, and file utilities.

methods.name: getAllOpenaiAssistants
methods.description: Fetches a list of all OpenAI assistants associated with a given credential ID, decrypting credentials and handling errors.

methods.name: getSingleOpenaiAssistant
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific OpenAI assistant, including associated files and vector store data, with error handling.

methods.name: uploadFilesToAssistant
methods.description: Uploads multiple files to an OpenAI assistant, decrypting credentials, converting files, and cleaning up uploads.
